facts.rationale: A blend-qualified wrapper name distinguishes this entry point from the implementation while preserving the established Wait family.

evidence.why: Delegates directly to ft_8008A348 with anim_blend equal to -1.0f. It adds no state-selection policy of its own. A grounded mushroom-transformation finalizer calls this wrapper; the airborne path instead invokes a stored callback.

facts.rationale: The explicit blend parameter is the directly supported distinction between this implementation and its wrapper.

evidence.why: Accepts an animation-blend argument. It first permits DownSpot and a second conditional common-state route to bypass Wait. Otherwise it handles an airborne fighter, performs Peach-parasol handling, changes to ftCo_MS_Wait using the supplied blend, conditionally invokes the DeadUpFall-related helper, and performs common and Link/Young Link setup. The ordinary action-ending dispatcher passes zero, whereas ft_8008A324 passes -1.0f.
